macro.purpose: To support the full lifecycle of personal projects — from initial idea through final release — by automating construction, updates, and every modification in between. Covering development, design, and deployment, the platform grows toward full automation: every step guided or executed without manual intervention, across projects of any size, over months of tasks, refinement, and learning.
macro.longTermVision: Refinement of existing features, improved performance, more efficient token usage, expanded templates with user-created template support, and cross-platform portability.

role.title: Sole Developer & Owner
responsibilities: Architecture, implementation, testing, and release of all platform features

keyHighlights: Full project lifecycle automation (create → develop → maintain → release)
Analytics on all agent activity with routing telemetry
Game mod creation for any game with local modding tools
Build new projects from prompts with 6+ templates
Plans, designs, and PM-driven development with macro/micro roadmaps
Agent-automated development guided by the owner

decisions.decision: project-plan.json is the sole source of truth for roadmap and feature tracking
decisions.rationale: PRODUCT_ROADMAP.md was massively stale (showed 5% Release coverage when most features were done). Single source prevents drift.

decisions.decision: Merge feature/real-data into dev before backfilling roadmap
decisions.rationale: Clean baseline needed — 205 commits ahead, no merge conflicts, fast-forward merge

decisions.decision: Sequential Playwright agents for page health inventory
decisions.rationale: App has 42+ pages — too large for single agent context. Chunked into top-level (A1) and project sub-pages (A2)

decisions.decision: Keep JSON for v0.1, migrate runtime state to SQLite in v0.2
decisions.rationale: JSON works for single-user localhost but doesn't scale — no indexing, no queries, no reactivity. .playground/ already has 15+ JSON files with read-parse-write cycles. SQLite migration will consolidate tasks, sessions, analytics, incidents, and sync state into a queryable store with proper indexing.

decisions.decision: Branch per task, PR per sprint group for agent execution
decisions.rationale: Solo dev with agents — PRs per task create merge overhead, but per-sprint gives clean rollback. Agents work on isolated branches (sprint-1/task-deps, sprint-1/release-endpoint), batch-merge into one sprint PR for review.

decisions.decision: Templates marked done (17 exist), Create with AI added to v0.2
decisions.rationale: Roadmap said 6 templates, but 17 actually exist (blank, sveltekit, nextjs, python, python-cli, fullstack, agent, go, rust, ruby, java, dotnet, bepinex, fabric, forge, paper, bg3). Template params also done. The real gap is Create with AI — agent-driven project setup for novel frameworks where static templates can't capture the nuances.

decisions.decision: No Sprint 0 needed — all 8 backend security issues already fixed
decisions.rationale: Security verification confirmed all 8 issues (TOCTOU races, shell injection, gateway hangs, tool bypass, FD leaks, task mutation, dropped replies, tool message exclusion) were fixed across 5 commits: b6d313d, 0dde6ad, 1f6e77c, 1898d6a, e3798e7. AsyncMutex, execFile with arrays, per-request isolation, confirmation gates all verified in code.
